data.title: Parental allowance (Elterngeld) decision for daughter Ida
data.summary: The Kreisverwaltung Beispiel-Eifel (Elterngeldstelle) approved Basiselterngeld for Selma Musterfeld's daughter Ida for the 1st to 12th month of life (19 November 2024 to 18 November 2025), at €1,147.12 per month from the 3rd month onward (the first two months are offset against maternity pay/employer top-up and paid at €0).
data.explanation: This letter grants parental allowance (Elterngeld) for your daughter Ida, calculated from your net income before birth at a 65% replacement rate. For the first two months the amount is reduced to zero because maternity pay and employer top-up are credited against it; from the third month onward €1,147.12 is paid monthly. If you believe the calculation is wrong, you may file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the Elterngeldstelle — the app shows the deadline for this. If you take no action, the decision becomes final and payments continue as described. Since Elterngeld affects your tax rate via the progression clause, keep this letter for your tax return.
